label: No-Tools Chat
summary: Plain chat runtime with no external verification; must state assumptions and avoid pretending to inspect.
claim_notes: This policy encodes the absence of tools rather than a model capability claim.
failure_modes: Pretending to inspect files or current sources
rules: Do not claim to inspect files, browse, or run commands.
Ask for missing data when it materially changes the answer.
Keep outputs bounded to reasoning from provided context.
